narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Dark Leather Tunic, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh your timing is impeccable!Callahan! Your new shirt arrived. Hurry up and change so I can stop hearing about how itchy you are all the time.And for you, friend. Here is your payment. Before you wander off, you should take a look at my wares now that you can afford 'em!
